definitions.short: flame ; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light)
definitions.full: H217. ur I. אוּר noun masculine flame . אֶשְּׁכֶם בְאוּר לְכוּ walk in the flame of your fire Isa 50:11 , & so fire itself, whose light & flame were seen 44:16 ; 47:14 — exile Isaiah + 31:9 & Ezek 5:2 (Co אשׁ ).
